title: Projects view — wider fade, heading size

steps.path: Projects → Conversations, a long list scrolled down
steps.headline: Wider fade (72px instead of 40px) — keep?
steps.changed: The fade at the top and bottom of each tab's list is almost twice as tall, so a card passing under the edge fades out completely (its outline and rounded corners too), not just its first line.
steps.notice: The heading in these pictures is the 14px option from the next step.

steps.headline: Which heading size?

variants.label: 18px · Large (A)
variants.summary: The guide's Large heading, as last time.

variants.label: 16px
variants.summary: Main text colour, medium weight: the same size as a popup's title, but lighter.

variants.label: 14px
variants.summary: Main text colour, medium weight: the size of normal text, set apart by weight and colour.

variants.label: 12px · small label (B)
variants.summary: The small grey label, as last time.

steps.notice: The guide allows three heading sizes. A 16px or 14px pick would become the full-screen size, replacing 18px Large, so Marketplace and Library would follow it later rather than a fourth size being added.
